purpose: Six original painted interaction props; preserved alpha, runtime source rectangles only.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent sprite atlas for When the Sky Clears, a painted side-view survival platform game. Create a single production sprite sheet with exactly SIX separate objects in a strict evenly spaced 3 columns by 2 rows grid. Leave clear transparent gutters and transparent background around every object. Art direction: finely hand-painted weathered European wartime civilian props, same rich believable canvas folds, rough wood grain, worn iron, warm cream highlights and soft cool grey shadows as a detailed small refugee tent; readable lit midtones, not black silhouettes. Side elevation with a very slight view of top planes, no isometric perspective, no people, no setting, no text, no UI, no grid lines, no logos. Each object complete and centered with generous padding in its own equal rectangular cell. TOP ROW left: low wooden ration box with hinged lid leaning open, folded oatmeal linen, two modest tins and wrapped bread visible. TOP ROW middle: old ochre canvas civilian medicine satchel standing open with rolled ivory bandages and one small amber bottle, no emblems. TOP ROW right: loosely rolled grey-green canvas tool bundle holding a short rope coil, dull iron wrench and salvaged iron brackets. BOTTOM ROW left: full cast-iron hand water pump BODY on a worn stone footing, about waist high, rust-patina grey green, curved spout pointing left, pivot bearing at very top; DO NOT attach the long lever, it will be animated separately. BOTTOM ROW middle: one detached horizontal straight pump lever, metal end at left has circular pivot hole, long weathered wooden handle extending to the right, entire piece isolated and horizontal. BOTTOM ROW right: small squat amber glass oil lantern with detailed soot-marked iron frame and soft warm flame contained within glass, hanging ring at top; no surrounding glow outside glass. Consistent brushwork and light direction across all six objects. Finely detailed edges without hard outline, refined grounded materials, realistic use and age. Genuine alpha transparency, no baked checkerboard.
